name: Urea fluid-bed granulator
description: Fluid-bed unit that builds urea granules from sprayed melt onto seed particles, with internal recycling and classification to hold a target granule size. Granules are larger and harder than prills, which suits bulk blending and reduces caking.

specifications.basis: SAFCO IV granulation unit; more than 20 plants have capacities of 3,000 t/d or more
